title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramel Latte 10ml  E-Liquid
description: Caramel Latte by Vampire Vape Desserts recreates the familiar warmth of your favourite coffee shop treat, combining deep, roasted Coffee flavour with a drizzle of sweet Caramel and a layer of smooth, steamed milk. This balanced vape offers depth and sweetness, making it an endlessly enjoyable all-day option for coffee and dessert flavour fans. Available in 0mg, 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg freebase nicotine strengths, Caramel Latte is blended for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter devices, and vape pens. The 3mg strength features a 50VG/50PG ratio, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg options use a 40VG/60PG blend to provide enhanced flavour clarity and a more pronounced throat hit. Made in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, this e-liquid is part of Vampire Vape’s new Desserts collection — a range designed to bring indulgent dessert and café-inspired experiences to your everyday vape. Also available in High-VG Shortfills and DIY Concentrates.
